mentions.name: benchix
mentions.description: A Linux-subset ABI x86-64 kernel written in Rust, built as a learning project to understand OS kernels. Work in progress includes adding tracing support and developing allocators, exploring fallible allocation, overcommit approaches, and OOM handling.
mentions.source_excerpt: Now I'm going to be working on my Linux-subset ABI x86-64 kernel [0], specifically adding support for tracing, then working on allocators. It's written in Rust so I might have to figure out how to make allocation fallible like the Linux kernel does.
